summary_1line: Kunti invokes gods to bear sons for Pandu, giving birth to Yudhishthira and Bhima, while Pandu begins austerities seeking a third heroic son from Indra.

image_candidates.scene_text: The radiant god of justice appears in a sun-bright chariot before Kunti as she performs sacred incantations to summon him.
Infant Bhima falls from Kunti’s lap onto a mountain rock, shattering the stone into fragments while the child remains unharmed.
King Pandu stands on one leg in severe austerity amid the forest while sages watch, seeking Indra’s favor for a mighty son.
